name: gullyclean-launcher
description: GullyClean Waste Management System - Unified Launcher

scripts.dev: npx concurrently -n "API,CITIZEN,WORKER,ADMIN" -c "yellow,green,blue,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix worker" "npm run dev --prefix admin"
scripts.install-all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix worker && npm install --prefix admin
